an6.50:1.1: Indriyasaṃvare bhikkhave asati indriyasaṃvaravipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti sīlaṃ,
an6.50:1.2: sīle asati sīlavipannassa hatupaniso hoti sammāsamādhi,
an6.50:1.3: sammāsamādhimhi asati sammāsamādhivipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ,
an6.50:1.4: yathābhūtañāṇadassane asati yathābhūtañāṇadassanavipannassa hatupaniso hoti nibbidāvirāgo,
an6.50:1.5: nibbidāvirāge asati nibbidāvirāgavipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ. 2.
an6.50:1.7: tassa papaṭikā pi na pāripūriṃ gacchati, taco pi na pāripūriṃ gacchati, pheggu pi na pāripūriṃ gacchati, sāro pi na pāripūriṃ gacchati,
an6.50:1.8: evam eva kho bhikkhave indriyasaṃvare asati indriyasaṃvaravipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti . . . pe . . .
an6.50:2.1: Indriyasaṃvare bhikkhave sati indriyasaṃvarasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti sīlaṃ,
an6.50:2.2: sīle sati sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti sammāsamādhi,
an6.50:2.3: sammāsamādhimhi sati sammāsamādhisampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ,
an6.50:2.4: yathābhūtañāṇadassane sati yathābhūtañāṇadassanasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti nibbidāvirāgo,
an6.50:2.5: nibbidāvirāge sati nibbidāvirāgasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ. 4.
an6.50:2.6: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave rukkho sākhāpalāsasampanno , tassa papaṭikā pi pāripūriṃ gacchati, taco pi pāripūriṃ gacchati, pheggu pi pāripūriṃ gacchati, sāro pi pāripūriṃ gacchati,
an6.50:2.7: evam eva kho bhikkhave indriyasaṃvare sati indriyasaṃvarasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti . . . pe . . .
